name: ad-platform-updates
description: What changed in Meta and Google Ads, with dates and sources.

interface.longDescription:
Ask what changed in Meta (Facebook and Instagram) or Google Ads this week, whether a feature is live, or why costs moved, and get dated summaries of platform announcements, trade press and practitioner reports, each with its source link and how well it's verified. Refreshed daily from Sum Digital's ad platform research.

Read-only: it reports public news and does not connect to or change any ad account. Practitioner reports are labeled as reports, not confirmed facts.
capabilities: Recent Meta and Google Ads changes
Search ad platform updates by topic
defaultPrompt: What changed in Meta ads this week?
Did Google change anything about AI Max reporting?
Is anyone else seeing Meta CPMs spike?

positive.prompt: What changed in Meta ads this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists dated Meta items from the last 7 days, newest first, each with a source link; practitioner reports are presented as reports, not confirmed facts.

positive.prompt: Any news on Google AI Max reporting?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes the dated AI Max reporting items (e.g. the September 2026 reporting expansion) with links to the sources.

positive.prompt: My Meta CPMs jumped this week. Is anyone else seeing that?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns recent Meta items about CPM or delivery shifts with dates and links, and says whether each is a confirmed announcement or a practitioner report.

positive.prompt: Only confirmed announcements: what did Google Ads change in the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls with platform google, days 30, verified_only true and lists only items verified against the primary source, with dates and links.

positive.prompt: Give me a quick rundown of Meta and Google Ads changes from the past two weeks.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls with platform both and days 14; groups or labels items by platform with dates and links.

negative.description: Account changes are out of scope. The app is read-only news; it has no access to ad accounts. Expected: explain it cannot change campaigns and does not call a tool to try.
negative.prompt: Pause my Meta campaign called Spring Sale.

negative.description: Private account data is out of scope. The app has no account access. Expected: say it cannot see account data; optionally offer recent Google Ads changes instead.
negative.prompt: How much did my Google Ads account spend yesterday?
What's the weather in Chicago tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: This app does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial ChatGPT release: recent changes and topic search across Meta and Google Ads updates.
